Memory.title: Memory
Memory.description: A user's synthesized personal memory record and context inquiry transcript

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the memory owner

title.description: Descriptive title of the memory or decision

approximateDate.description: Approximate date or timeframe of the memory

category.description: Category: Career, Decisions, Projects, Health, Personal, Relationships, Milestone

whatHappened.description: Summary of the core event or decision

importantContext.description: Unstated pressures, constraints, and mental model at the time

goalsOrDecisions.description: Specific goals sought and trade-offs made

whatChanged.description: Subsequent shifts, mindset evolution, or changed reality

whatRemainsUnclear.description: Lingering uncertainties, doubts, or unresolved questions

conversation.description: Multi-turn interview transcript between user and Gemini scribe

/users/{userId}/memories/{memoryId}.description: Private memories isolated strictly per authenticated user UID
